skill.summary: Control Unity Editor via OpenClaw Unity Plugin. Use for Unity game development tasks including scene management, GameObject/Component manipulation, debugging, input simulation, and Play mode control. Triggers on Unity-related requests like inspecting scenes, creating objects, taking screenshots, testing gameplay, or controlling the Editor.
